question: _________ are plants that have seeds but no fruits.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gymnosperms**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Gymnosperms **are flowering plants that produce **seeds **but **no fruits**.
 
• **Conifers, cycads, Ginkgo, **and **gnetophytes** are among the seed-producing plants of the clade Gymnospermae that make up the gymnosperms.
 
• The name "gymnosperm" is derived from a **Greek **compound word that literally translates to** "naked seeds."**
 
• The term refers to the fact that **seeds **are not contained (called **ovules **in their unfertilized state).
 
• In contrast to the seeds and ovules of **blooming plants (angiosperms)**, which are enclosed within an **ovary**, their seeds are not encased.
 
• Gymnosperm seeds can **grow alone**, as in the case of **yew**, Torreya, and ginkgo, or on the surface of scales or leaves, which are frequently modified to create cones. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Pteridophytes: **

 
 
• **​**A **pteridophyte **is vascular plant that produces spores and has **xylem **and **phloem**.
 
• Pteridophytes are frequently referred to as the "cryptogams," which indicates that their reproductive strategy is concealed, because they don't produce blooms or seeds.
 
 
 
• **Mosses:**
 
 
• **​​**Small, non-vascular, flowerless plants called mosses belong to biological group **Bryophyta**.
 
• In wet or shaded areas, **mosses **frequently develop **dense, green mats** or the **clumps**.
 
• The basic leaves on individual plants are typically only one **cell thick**, linked to stem** **that may or may not have branches, and play very limited role in transporting **water **and **nutrients**.
 
 
 
• **Bryophytes:**
 
 
• **​**The** liverworts, hornworts, and mosses** are three groups of non-vascular land plants that make up the proposed **taxonomic **division known as the **Bryophyta s.l.**
 
• All that makes up **Bryophyta s.s. **are **mosses**.
 
• Though they may thrive in the dry areas, they are typically small and prefer **damp surroundings**.
